title: Ashgrove Income Annuity Tiers — Payment Schedule Options Card
content:
The payment schedule options of Income Annuities are identical on all six tiers — Ashgrove Income Annuity Life Only, Cash Refund, 10-Year Certain, 20-Year Certain, Joint 50% Survivor and Joint 100% Survivor.

| Option | Figure on every tier | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Earliest first payment date | 30 calendar days after the issue date | The first payment date may be no earlier than this |
| Latest first payment date | 13 calendar months after the issue date | The first payment date may be no later than this |
| Installment frequencies offered | Monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual | The frequencies a contract may be issued with |
| Smallest gross installment | $100 | A lower installment requires a less frequent mode |
| Frequency change after issue | Not allowed | The payment frequency may not be changed after issue |
| Cost-of-living increase rates at purchase | 0%, 1%, 2% or 3% a year | The annual increase rates that may be chosen at purchase |
| First cost-of-living increase | Contract anniversary 1 | The anniversary on which the first cost-of-living increase applies |
| Latest payment day | Day 28 of the month | The latest day of the month that may be chosen as the payment day |
| Assignment of payments | Not allowed | Whether income payments may be assigned, sold or pledged |

**Hypothetical readings.**

- Issue date 1 March: a first payment date of 31 March is 30 days after issue and meets the earliest date; 30 March, at 29 days, does not.
- A monthly installment that would come to $85 is below the $100 smallest installment, so a less frequent mode is needed; quarterly, the same income would be $255 an installment.
- A payment day of the 28th is available; the 29th, 30th and 31st are not.
- A cost-of-living rate of 2% is one of the offered rates; 2.5% is not.
